31:2.text: These are Verses of the Wise Book

31:3.text: A guide and a mercy for the Muhsinûn

31:4.text: and give Zakât and they have faith in the Hereafter with certainty.

31:5.text: Such are on guidance from their Lord, and such are the successful.

31:6.text: And of mankind is he who purchases idle talks
from the Path of Allâh without knowledge, and takes it
(the Path of Allâh, or the Verses of the Qur’ân)
by way of mockery. For such there will be a humiliating torment

31:7.text: are recited to such a one, he turns away in pride,
as if he heard them not - as if there were deafness in his ear. So announce to him a painful torment.

31:8.text: and do righteous good deeds, for them are Gardens of Delight

31:9.text: To abide therein. It is a Promise of Allâh in truth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

31:10.text: He has created the heavens without any pillars that you see, and has set on the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with you. And He has scattered therein moving
creatures of all kinds. And We send down water
from the sky, and We cause
of every goodly kind to grow therein.

31:11.text: This is the creation of Allâh. So show Me that which those
besides Him have created. Nay, the Zâlimûn
(polytheists, wrongdoers and those who do not believe in the Oneness of Allâh)
